facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.run_fixed_trajectory: run a fixed robot trajectory with a StretchClient and RosMapDataCollector to navigate waypoints
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.run_exploration: run frontier-based exploration using RRTConnect planning on a Stretch robot with voxel map data
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.collect_data: collect 3D map data from a Stretch robot via ROS and save point cloud and voxel map files
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.load_and_visualize_pkl: load a pickled SparseVoxelMap from a file and visualize 2D obstacle and explored maps
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.plan_paths_on_voxel_map: plan RRTConnect paths between frontier goals on a SparseVoxelMapNavigationSpace and visualize the planned trajectories

facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.run_stretch_robot_demo: run the Stretch robot demo to explore, find objects, and place them using click CLI options
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.run_manipulation_test: run a manipulation test that switches to manipulation mode and attempts to grasp and place objects
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.run_exploration_with_vlm: run robot exploration with a remote VLM server for visual language model planning via RPC
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.save_voxel_map: save the robot's voxel map as a PCD point cloud and pickle file after exploration completes
facebookresearch_home-robot/src/home_rob.test_grasping: test grasping functionality by running the demo with the test-grasping flag enabled
